queries.name: GetImportSourceStatus
queries.output: configured-directory availability, immutable profile/header/vocabulary/parser IDs, current source checkpoint chronology/fingerprint/run identity, latest run summary and actionable state
rules: checkpoint chronology labelled import ordering only

queries.name: ListImportRuns
queries.output: keyset page ordered started_at_utc DESC/import_run_id with source profile, candidate filename/chronology, fingerprint, state and exact counts
rules: unpublished discovering/validating rows appear only in technical job/status view, never as reviewed source history

queries.name: GetImportRun
queries.output: exact immutable candidate/profile provenance, source/checkpoint comparison, fingerprint/replay classification, exact counts, run state and review completion state

queries.name: ListPublishedSourceObservations
queries.output: published normalized row observations with canonical identity/presence/row locator and bounded allowlisted field evidence
rules: query rejects unpublished validating run as review source
physical row order is displayed provenance only

queries.name: ListImportFindings
queries.output: exact finding totals/page with code, scope, linked observation/field and bounded explanation

queries.name: ListReconciliationProposals
queries.output: proposal identities, risk, target identity, source observation, base-state/proposal fingerprints, change count and disposition
rules: exact total count remains available independent of pagination

queries.name: GetProposalReview
queries.output: exact source/run/profile provenance, current proposal revision/fingerprint, typed before/after changes, risk reasons, current target preview from owning readers, stale-state indicator and allowed dispositions
rules: terminal RFC review states explicitly that acceptance creates pending cascade but does not execute it

queries.name: PreviewImportRecovery
queries.output: current checkpoint and candidate chronology/fingerprint, exact review fingerprint, reason conflict|older, proposal/findings counts, consequences and allowed reject/defer/authorize-correction actions
queries.rule: never describes file mtime/import time as RFC business chronology

queries.name: GetWfmPlanReviewContext
queries.output: provider source plan, current accepted operational Task plan/lock/outcome state supplied by LLD-05, source chronology, plan diff and separate Objective-regrouping consequence indicator
queries.rule: Objective grouping itself is not accepted through LLD-04

pagination: All unbounded LLD-04 lists use deterministic keyset pagination and bounds.json page limits. Exact totals are derived from persisted run/proposal/finding counts or indexed COUNT queries and never approximated by loaded page size.
